observation.text: Global :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid !important } caused concentric double focus frames on search inputs enclosed in focus-within container cards

cited_events.claim: Single Focus Frame Invariant collision on #search-input

recommendation: Scope form inputs (input/textarea/select) to border + box-shadow glow and override nested search inputs to border:none, outline:none !important so only the container renders the focus frame

observation.text: macOS WKWebView AVFoundation (CRABS) failed with OSStatus -12190 FormatError when proxying raw YouTube ftypdash streams because full-file Range requests trigger YouTube CDN 32KB/s throttling and 200+ moof box seeks; additionally auth.js x-guest-id headers caused standalone desktop loopback requests to be downgraded to guest and blocked with HTTP 403 on /api/queue/add

cited_events.claim: macOS WKWebView FormatError -12190 and HTTP 403 desktop loopback

recommendation: Fetch googlevideo.com streams in bounded 512KB Range chunks piped through ffmpeg progressive audio/mpeg (200 OK), set TUNEFLOW_DESKTOP_LOCAL=1 for loopback auto-admin in standalone desktop mode, and persist operational logs to LOGS_DIR/tuneflow.log
